title: Add representative workload runners and reporting pipeline v5
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: consolidate representative workload runners, add profiling baselines, and deploy reporting pipeline v5 to support multi-arch summaries and KV-cache-aware metrics. This PR includes: - new 'representative' runner templates for Llama2/Redwood-7B-like workloads, with realistic sequence length distributions and batching profiles; - profiling baselines and harness for CPU/GPU (nv-prof/torchprof) to standardize latency/p99 measurement; - reporting pipeline v5: ingestion adapters, schema migration for 'batch_shape' and 'cache_hit' fields, and dashboard config for per-model warmup curves; - small docs and quickstart for running the lab locally. Checklist: - [x] Add workload runner templates and configs - [x] Add profiling baseline harness and sample outputs - [x] Add reporting pipeline adapters and migrations - [x] Add CI to run a lightweight smoke benchmark on PRs - [x] Update docs and quickstarts Related: ENG-1345 (standardize benchmarks), ENG-1987 (reporting infra improvements). Note: this is the V5 pipeline iteration after v4 hotfixes — main differences are the additional cache_hit metrics and a lightweight PR smoke test to prevent regressions.

review_comments: Liam Chen (requested changes) - The runner looks good; please add a comment explaining the heuristic for 'batch_shape' selection and ensure the default matches our typical 8k token workload. Also add a unit test for the batch selector edge case.

Ava Martinez (author reply) - Added detailed docstring and unit test for batch selector. The default is derived from recent telemetry (see configs/llama2_7b.json) and I added a reference comment. PTAL.

Noah Patel (comment) - Reporting adapter needs defensive parsing for older events that don't include 'cache_hit'. I propose a migration that backfills with nulls and a feature flag to enable the new column.
Ava Martinez (author reply) - Implemented migration_20251112.sql and feature flag 'reporting_v5_enabled' in adapter. Adapter now tolerates absent 'cache_hit' and emits a warning to logging.
Sophia Williams (approval) - Verified smoke CI run and reviewed sample profiling outputs. Approving — dashboard JSON will be iterated but can be updated separately.
CI (automated) - First run: bench-smoke failed due to Dockerfile missing 'python3-distutils'. Fixed in follow-up commit and re-ran — all checks passed.
release_notes: Add V5 benchmark reporting pipeline with representative workload runners and profiling baselines. Includes CI smoke test to catch regressions. Backwards-compatible schema migration for reporting; feature-flagged 'cache_hit' column.
